ⓘ AMS-CB PRO — 3-Tier Hybrid Studio Architecture

Anya Music Studios - Cyber Band PRO (AMS-CB PRO) combines 3 selectable local audio tiers inside a single studio file — scaling seamlessly from zero-download offline synthesis up to sampled SoundFont instruments and WebGPU neural singing:

⚡ Tier 1 (Cyber Core · 0 MB): Pure procedural PolyBLEP analog synths + offline eSpeak/TD-PSOLA & 8-band stereo vocoder.

🎹 Tier 2 (SF2/SF3 Sampled Studio): Powered by SpessaSynth with a built-in 32-preset Physical-Modeling GM SoundFont out-of-the-box, 1-click GeneralUser GS (.sf3) live sampled instruments cached in IndexedDB, and custom .sf2/.sf3/.dls bank import with continuous SF2 ↔ Cyber Synth Blend.

🧠 Tier 3 (WebGPU Neural Vocal & RVC v2): Synthesizes natural neural vocals via Kokoro-82M ONNX (Apache-2.0) on WebGPU/WASM and supports custom RVC v2 (.onnx) singer conversion where the composer's exact MIDI melody drives pitchf directly (zero pitch-estimation warble) plus optical vocal compression & de-essing.

🎤 Articulated Sung Vocals: English lyrics (tagged or untagged) are synthesized phonetically via an embedded eSpeak/meSpeak engine and pitch-locked syllable-by-syllable onto scale-aware melodies using first-peak epoch TD-PSOLA (Female, Male, Harmonic Duet, and 8-Band PolyBLEP Stereo Vocoder), with automatic instrumental pocket ducking.

🎚 Suno-Style Cyber Steering: Max Mode activates chorus 3rd harmonies, sub-bass reinforcement & high-band air exciter; Style Consistency, Weirdness, Audio Consistency, Variety, Negative Prompt, and Personalize dynamically steer harmonic progressions, syncopation, FX sends, and stem exclusions.

💿 Up to 10:00 Duration & Mastering: Uses stateful 12-second block-floating-point stem streaming for low-memory 8:00 & 10:00 epics, exporting TPDF-dithered 24-bit Stereo WAV, 320 kbps CBR Stereo MP3 (via LAME/lamejs, LGPL), Format-1 MIDI, and 24-bit Stem ZIP bundles.
